description.value: G&G Kitchen and Tap is a comfort food restaurant in Sicamous, British Columbia, offering breakfast, lunch, and supper alongside a selection of craft beers and cocktails. Operated by IGB Hospitality Group Ltd., it is described as cozy and inviting, suited to a leisurely sit-down meal. Its location on Eagle Pass Way places it in Sicamous, a small community at the junction of major BC travel corridors.
